HardwareFilter.Description: 0.01-200 Hz bandpass (8th order Chebyshev), 50 Hz notch

TaskDescription: Trial-based paradigm with sustained movements/motor imagery. Each trial: fixation cross at 0s, cue presentation at 2s, sustained movement/MI execution. Subjects performed both movement execution (ME) and motor imagery (MI) in separate sessions.
Instructions: Subjects were instructed to execute sustained movements in ME session and perform kinesthetic motor imagery in MI session. For rest class, subjects were instructed to avoid any movement and to stay in the starting position.
